title: Cities with the busiest metro systems
prompt: Name the 10 cities whose metro system carries the most passengers a year

fact.text: China's Shanghai Metro set its one-day record of 13.39 million rides on 9 March 2024.
Opened in 1971, the Beijing Subway is China's oldest metro, and since 2023 the world's longest.
Its Guangfo Line, to neighbouring Foshan, was the first metro line in China to link two cities.
China's Shenzhen Metro only opened in 2004, yet it is already the world's 5th longest metro system.
The world's first virtual supermarket for smartphones opened in 2011 at a Seoul Subway station, South Korea.
Japan's Tokyo Metro opened in 1927 as the Tokyo Underground Railway, the first subway in Asia.

answers.name: Delhi
aliases: National Capital Territory of Delhi, India

fact.text: The Delhi Metro, India's largest and busiest, opened its first stretch on Christmas Day 2002.
Russia's Moscow Metro is the only metro system in the world with three circle lines.
In China's Chengdu, about 4.6 million people live within 800 m of a metro station (2021).
